mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals an acceleration in economic activity that boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth decelerates below its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months, the signal should fail to predict positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rebounds above its 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months, the signal should fail to predict negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above its 12-month moving average signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS declines below its 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months, the signal should fail to predict negative returns.

failure_condition: If UNRATE declines below its 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months, the signal should fail to predict negative returns.
